sources.title: Justbackup/LFM2-24B-A2B-abliterated · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Unrestricted version of LiquidAI/LFM2-24B-A2B, created using Abliterix. This is the first abliterated model based on Liquid AI's hybrid gated short convolution + grouped query attention architecture with Mixture of Experts.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B: Scaling Up the LFM2 Architecture - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: Today, we release an early checkpoint of LFM2-24B-A2B, our largest LFM2 model. This sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) model has 24 billion total parameters with 2 billion active per token, showing that the LFM2 architecture scales effectively to larger sizes.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B - docs.liquid.ai
sources.snippet: 24B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 2B active parameters — our largest model for laptops and single-GPU applications ← Back to Text Models LFM2-24B-A2B is Liquid AI's largest Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 24B total parameters with only 2B active parameters per forward pass.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2 is a family of hybrid models designed for on-device deployment. LFM2-24B-A2B is the largest model in the family, scaling the architecture to 24 billion parameters while keeping inference efficient.
